releaseNotes: Arabic Search Hardening: PP-OCRv5 Arabic is now the primary on-device OCR path with more tolerant text detection for faint Arabic scans. EasyOCR remains a best-effort fallback and can no longer suppress valid Paddle output if its model or decode fails. Raw OCR plus safe RTL variants are preserved, Arabic search adds Unicode NFKC/zero-width normalization and bounded fuzzy matching for small OCR mistakes, and arabic_repair_v5 retries prior Arabic repair attempts lazily without clearing the completed Smart Search index.
